detail.longDescription: Process ID isolation is a fundamental confinement employed by today's container engines, including containers running on # Kubernetes . But as every feature, it can be turned off. With # docker , # podman or # nerdctl you can pass the `--pid=host` flag, on Kubernetes you can have all containers in a pod share the PID namespace using `shareProcessNamespace: true`. Forbidding this (sometimes unwanted) feature is easy with # Kubewarden , find out how in our newest blog post 👇 https://www. kubewarden.io/blog/2026/09/pre vent-sharing-pid-namespace/
